items.exampleEn: He is too passive; he never shares his ideas in class.
items.exampleZh: 他太被動了，上課從不分享自己的想法。

items.exampleEn: He looked miserable after losing the game.
items.exampleZh: 輸了比賽後，他看起來很難過。

items.exampleEn: To my embarrassment, I forgot her name.
items.exampleZh: 讓我尷尬的是，我忘了她的名字。

items.exampleEn: What fascinates you most about history?
items.exampleZh: 歷史最讓你著迷的是什麼？

items.exampleEn: Try to make your speech short and memorable.
items.exampleZh: 試著讓你的演講簡短又令人難忘。

items.exampleEn: It was shocking to see how much the town had changed.
items.exampleZh: 看到小鎮變了這麼多，真令人震驚。

items.exampleEn: You'll be amazed at how easy this game is.
items.exampleZh: 你會驚訝這個遊戲有多簡單。

items.sentenceEn: Don't be so passive; tell us what you think.
items.sentenceZh: 別這麼被動，告訴我們你的想法。

items.audioEn: I was amazed by the magic show. The man made a car disappear!
items.audioZh: 魔術表演讓我很驚訝，那個人讓一輛車消失了！
options: A car was there, then it wasn't.
He flew over the people watching.
He drove a car on stage.

items.sentenceEn: Don't be foolish; take an umbrella.
The ending of the story was shocking.

items.stemEn: Losing my wallet and missing the bus made it a ____ day.
items.stemZh: 掉了錢包又沒趕上公車，那天真是悲慘的一天。

items.stemEn: I was ____ to see that my little brother had cleaned the whole house.
items.stemZh: 我很驚訝地看到我弟弟把整間房子都打掃乾淨了。

items.passageEn: Last month, our class went to the city ocean museum. At first, I was passive and just followed the group, because I thought fish were boring. But then the sea turtles fascinated me, and I was amazed by how big they were. The guide told us a shocking fact: every year, a huge amount of plastic ends up in the sea. My friend Ben tried to touch a fish in a shallow pool, which was foolish, and he fell in. He was wet and miserable, and he looked down in embarrassment. Everyone laughed, but our teacher helped him. In the end, the trip was memorable in a funny way.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我們班去了市立海洋館。一開始我很被動，只是跟著大家走，因為我覺得魚很無聊。但後來海龜深深吸引了我，我很驚訝牠們竟然那麼大。導覽員告訴我們一個令人震驚的事實：每年都有大量的塑膠流進海裡。我的朋友 Ben 想去摸淺水池裡的魚，這實在很傻，結果他掉了進去。他全身濕透，非常難受，尷尬地低下了頭。大家都笑了，但老師幫了他。最後，這趟校外教學以一種好笑的方式讓人難忘。

questions.questionZh: 一開始作者為什麼很被動？
options: 不喜歡和同學一起行動

questions.questionZh: Ben 掉進水池後怎麼了？
options: 全身濕透，尷尬地低下了頭

items.promptZh: 這部電影的故事讓我很著迷。
referenceEn: The story of this movie fascinated me.
I was fascinated by the story of this movie.
rubricZh: fascinate 表示「使著迷」，例如 be fascinated by… 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 memorable 造一個句子，說說你最難忘的一天或一次經驗。
referenceEn: My tenth birthday was the most memorable day of my life.
The trip to the beach with my family was memorable.
rubricZh: memorable 表示「難忘的」，例如 a memorable day 等說法
說的是自己的經驗（例如 I、my）
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）
